Week 9 · Transition · All roles

Reflect on Our Progress & Plan What’s Next

You’ve been exploring AI, trying new ways of working, and building new habits. Now it’s time to reflect on what’s changed and decide how your team will keep the momentum going.

◎WhoAll roles
↻FocusLearning & workflow improvement

Today’s Objective

Reflect on your team’s progress over the past eight weeks, identify the AI habits you want to keep building, and commit to how you’ll continue learning together through team huddles.

✦

Why this Huddle matters

After weeks of experimenting with AI and learning from one another, it’s time to reflect and take ownership of what’s next. Continuing to build AI habits strengthens our Customer Zero experiences and the insights we bring to customers.

Desired outcome

A shared understanding of what’s changed, the habits worth continuing, and how the team will keep learning, along with an agreed-upon topic for Week 10.

✦

What we’ll cover

A
Reflect on our experience

What has changed in how we think about and use AI?

B
Identify what’s worth continuing

Which habits are sticking, and where do we still need practice?

C
Plan what’s next

Agree on how we’ll continue our huddles and choose a topic for Week 10.

✦

Where we are in the journey

From guided activation to ongoing, team-owned learning.

Explore the huddle journey

Week 1 · All roles · Orientation

Understand the huddle experience, explore the Top 5 agents, and get ready to learn through real work.

Weeks 2–8 · Role-specific · Activation

Practice guided workflows relevant to your role and bring back useful examples, questions, and friction.

You are here: Week 9 · Transition

Week 9 · All roles · Transition

Use evidence from the guided journey to decide what to keep, what needs support, and which work priority to explore next.

Weeks 10+ · Role-relevant · Sustain

Choose relevant topics as team needs change, test improvements in real work, and revisit what you learn together.

Accelerating AI confidence and capability through real work

THINK

Understand what’s possible

Adopt a Frontier mindset: dynamic, enterprise-ready, and human. Experience the value of AI as Customer Zero and see it as more than another tool.

FEEL

Gain confidence through experience

Build confidence through AI-backed preparation and shared experience. Share wins, learn from peers, and move from uncertainty to ownership.

DO

Apply AI and build new habits

Learn by doing in real work and daily workflows. Build fluency through peer sharing until useful AI habits become part of how you work.

Lasting transformation happens when AI becomes part of how work gets done every day.

Share Your Experience

Start with what you tried since the last huddle, then look back across the activation journey. Share what changed, which habits are taking hold, and how the team wants to keep learning.

Since the last huddle

  1. 01

    What did you try with AI since the last huddle?

  2. 02

    What worked well, and what did not?

  3. 03

    What did you learn, and where did you run into friction?

Looking back across the journey

Moments that mattered

  • What experience changed how you think about or use AI?
  • What are you doing differently today that you weren’t doing at the beginning of this motion?

Habits worth continuing

  • Which AI habits are becoming part of your everyday work?
  • What have you learned from one another that you want to keep building?

Make it our own

  • What has worked about our huddles, and what would we change?
  • What should our ongoing team huddles look like?

If a habit needs more practice or support, consider it as a future huddle topic.

Leave this stage with

A shared understanding of how far you’ve come, what’s worth continuing, and how you want to shape your team’s ongoing learning.

Strategic rationale

Why we continue · 3 min

Sustain

Huddles are not a one-time push. They give us space to keep practicing and make AI part of how we work.

Practice builds habits and confidence

The more we use AI in real work, the more natural it becomes. Continued practice builds our confidence and judgment about where AI adds value and where humans need to stay in the lead.

We learn and improve together

Sharing what worked, what didn’t, and what we learned helps everyone discover new approaches, build on each other’s experiences, and find better ways of working.

Customer Zero starts with us

Using AI ourselves gives us firsthand experience with what’s possible, what works, and what doesn’t—so we bring real insights and credibility into customer conversations.

To take customers to the Frontier, we go first.

Ongoing huddles give us space to keep experimenting, learn from one another, and turn new behaviors into lasting habits.
